Topologically Accurate Dual Isosurfacing Using Ray Intersection
We use thelook-up table to optimize the ray-intersection method to obtain minimum number of points necessarily sufficient for defining topologically correct isosurfaces in all possible configurations. Isosurface points are connected using a simple strategy. Keywords: Isosurface, Dual Contouring, Ray Intersection, Trilinear Interpolation
